title: Loft Profiles Must Be Topologically Similar
summary: If loft profiles differ strongly, insert intermediate profiles or use a different primitive.
modeling_notes: Trigger when profile_similarity_score < 0.7 or circle-to-rectangle is requested.
Remediate with an octagon or rounded rectangle intermediate profile.
Fallback to revolve sections when the intended shape is axisymmetric.
feature_pattern: if profile_similarity_score < 0.7 then add >= 1 intermediate profile before opLoft.
example_prompt: Loft a circle to a rectangle without twisting.

title: Sweep Path Must Be Connected
summary: Sweep path queries must resolve to one connected edge chain and the profile must be perpendicular to the path start.
modeling_notes: Trigger when opSweep path uses disjoint sketch entities.
Use one skArc or skFitSpline for elbows instead of separate loose lines.
Fallback to simple cylinder segments plus boolean union if the sweep fails.
feature_pattern: skArc/skFitSpline path + qCreatedBy(pathSketch, EntityType.EDGE) + perpendicular profile plane.

title: Revolve Profile Cannot Cross Axis
summary: Organic revolve profiles must remain on one side of the axis and close cleanly to the axis.
modeling_notes: Trigger when any spline x coordinate is negative or the spline crosses x=0.
Clamp x coordinates to >= 0.01 inch except explicit axis closure points.
Fallback to a cone/frustum template if spline repair fails.
feature_pattern: validate all profile x >= 0; close with top/base line segments and axis edge.
example_prompt: Organic carrot with five spline control points.

title: Organic Splines Need Enough Control Points
summary: A two-point spline collapses to a straight taper and should be replaced by a 5-7 point profile.
modeling_notes: Trigger when skFitSpline has fewer than 4 points for organic prompts.
Use percentage heights such as 0, 20, 45, 70, and 100 percent.
Expose curvatureFactor to let users tune the silhouette.
feature_pattern: 5 point skFitSpline with parameterized radii at percentage heights.
example_prompt: Create an organic carrot using a 5-point spline.

title: Sketch Region Queries Use Sketch Ids
summary: qSketchRegion must receive the sketch feature id expression, not the sketch variable.
modeling_notes: Trigger on qSketchRegion(sk) or qSketchRegion(sketch1).
Replace with qSketchRegion(id + "sketchName").
Use filterInnerLoops true for regions with holes.
example_prompt: Extrude a flange ring with bolt holes.

title: All Editable Parameters Must Be Exposed
summary: Any definition parameter used in the body must be declared in precondition with a supported FeatureScript form.
modeling_notes: Trigger when definition.foo is used without isLength/isInteger/boolean/Query declaration.
Length parameters use isLength(definition.foo, LENGTH_BOUNDS).
Integer parameters use isInteger(definition.foo, {(unitless): [min, default, max]}).
feature_pattern: precondition exposes every definition.* used in the body.
validation_rules: for each definition param in body exists precondition declaration
example_prompt: Expose baseRadius, height, curvatureFactor, and tipRadius.

title: Boolean Operations Need Valid Body Targets
summary: Boolean union/subtract operations must use body queries created by prior operations and must not target sketches.
modeling_notes: Trigger when opBoolean tools or targets query sketch entities.
Use qCreatedBy(operationId, EntityType.BODY) for both tools and targets.
Fallback to sketch inner loops for holes if subtractive tools are unstable.
validation_rules: tools and targets resolve to EntityType.BODY
example_prompt: Hybrid carrot body with mounting flange and bolt holes.

title: Shell Uses Face Entities Not ExcludeFaces
summary: FeatureScript opShell opens selected faces by passing them as entities; excludeFaces is not a valid key.
modeling_notes: Trigger when opShell contains excludeFaces.
Use qCapEntity(extrudeId, CapType.END, EntityType.FACE) as entities for open-top shells.
Fallback to explicit wall sketches if shell fails.
example_prompt: Open-top electronics enclosure with 0.1 inch walls.
